## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 403 captures during October 2024. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 403 captures, 21 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.2. The ungradable images could not be assessed for grading purposes. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to image capture and clinic processes that may affect whether images can be graded.

## Grading

Grading identified 111 referable results. These results were recorded from the captures that were suitable for assessment. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This indicates that grading was generally completed within a short interval after imaging. The results should continue to be reviewed through routine site monitoring, alongside the ungradable rate and the timeliness of grading. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading measures provide a summary of operations at Harbour Eye Clinic for October 2024.
